metadata.title: Integrable and non-integrable LR geodesic flows on 5-dimensional 2-step nilpotent Lie groups
metadata.abstract: We investigate sub-Riemannian geodesic flows on 5-dimensional nilpotent Lie groups endowed with left-invariant Riemannian metrics. Up to isomorphism, there are exactly two such groups: the Heisenberg group $H_5$ and the 5-dimensional nilpotent Lie group with a 2-dimensional commutator subgroup. For each group, we study geodesic flows associated with both left-invariant (LL) and right-invariant (LR) distributions, deriving explicit descriptions of the corresponding geodesics and comparing their integrability properties. While the LL systems are known to be Liouville integrable, and even superintegrable, we show that LR systems are Liouville integrable only in two cases: on the Heisenberg group and, for the second group, on a distinguished invariant level set.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 五维二步幂零群的亚黎曼测地流可积性
analysis.workSummary: 在文中两类五维二步幂零 Lie 群及左不变背景度量上，比较左不变分布（LL）与右不变分布（LR）的亚黎曼测地流，给出测地线描述。LL 系统已知超可积；作者称 LR 仅在 Heisenberg 群 H₅，以及另一群的特殊不变能级上为 Liouville 可积。
techniques: 左/右不变分布的 Hamilton 测地系统
Liouville 可积性与不变能级分析
analysis.breakthrough: 量化分布左右不变性的改变如何破坏既有可积结构。
analysis.limitations: 群分类范围是文中五维二步背景，不能泛指全部五维幂零群；特殊能级上的可积性也不等于该系统全局可积。分布与非可积性判据的额外条件须查正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 亚黎曼动力系统的具体比较，但偏可积系统专题。
